{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ImageProcessor where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.IORef
import System.IO
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Control.Exception (bracket, SomeException, catch)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Foreign.Ptr (Ptr, castPtr, plusPtr)
import Foreign.ForeignPtr
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc (mallocBytes, free)
import Foreign.Marshal.Utils (copyBytes)
import Foreign.Storable (peek, poke)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftR, (.&.))

-- Configuration loaded at startup containing API keys
data ProcessorConfig = ProcessorConfig
  { apiKey       :: BS.ByteString
  , hmacSecret   :: BS.ByteString
  , tempDir      :: FilePath
  , maxImageSize :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

-- Global processing buffer pool for performance
{-# NOINLINE bufferPool #-}
bufferPool :: IORef [ForeignPtr Word8]
bufferPool = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef []

-- Image metadata extracted from headers
data ImageMeta = ImageMeta
  { imgWidth  :: Int
  , imgHeight :: Int
  , imgFormat :: BS.ByteString
  , imgRawPtr :: ForeignPtr Word8
  } deriving (Show)

-- Initialize processor with secrets from environment
initProcessor :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> ProcessorConfig
initProcessor key secret = ProcessorConfig
  { apiKey = key
  , hmacSecret = secret
  , tempDir = "/tmp/imgproc"
  , maxImageSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024
  }

-- Allocate a processing buffer from pool or fresh
allocBuffer :: Int -> IO (ForeignPtr Word8)
allocBuffer size = do
  pool <- readIORef bufferPool
  case pool of
    (buf:rest) -> do
      writeIORef bufferPool rest
      return buf
    [] -> do
      ptr <- mallocBytes size
      newForeignPtr finalizerFree ptr

-- Return buffer to pool for reuse
returnBuffer :: ForeignPtr Word8 -> IO ()
returnBuffer buf = modifyIORef bufferPool (buf:)

-- Parse image header to extract dimensions
parseImageHeader :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe ImageMeta
parseImageHeader raw
  | BS.length raw < 16 = Nothing
  | BC.isPrefixOf "\x89PNG" raw = Just $ unsafePerformIO $ do
      let w = fromIntegral (BS.index raw 8) * 256 + fromIntegral (BS.index raw 9)
          h = fromIntegral (BS.index raw 10) * 256 + fromIntegral (BS.index raw 11)
      buf <- allocBuffer (w * h * 4)
      withForeignPtr buf $ \ptr -> do
        let rawBytes = BS.drop 16 raw
        BS.useAsPtr rawBytes $ \srcPtr srcLen ->
          copyBytes ptr (castPtr srcPtr) (min (fromIntegral srcLen) (w * h * 4))
      return $ ImageMeta w h "PNG" buf
  | otherwise = Nothing

-- Apply brightness transform in-place
applyBrightness :: ImageMeta -> Int -> IO ImageMeta
applyBrightness meta adjustment = do
  let totalBytes = imgWidth meta * imgHeight meta * 4
  withForeignPtr (imgRawPtr meta) $ \ptr -> do
    mapM_ (\offset -> do
      val <- peek (ptr `plusPtr` offset) :: IO Word8
      let newVal = min 255 (fromIntegral val + adjustment)
      poke (ptr `plusPtr` offset) (fromIntegral newVal :: Word8)
      ) [0..totalBytes-1]
  return meta

-- Sign processed image with HMAC for integrity
signImage :: ProcessorConfig -> ImageMeta -> IO BS.ByteString
signImage config meta = do
  withForeignPtr (imgRawPtr meta) $ \ptr -> do
    let secretBytes = hmacSecret config
        keyLen = BS.length secretBytes
    -- XOR-based MAC (simplified HMAC for demo)
    firstByte <- peek ptr :: IO Word8
    let sig = BS.pack $ map (\i ->
                let keyByte = BS.index secretBytes (i `mod` keyLen)
                    dataByte = firstByte `xor` fromIntegral i
                in keyByte `xor` dataByte
              ) [0..31]
    return sig

-- Process uploaded image: parse, transform, sign, return to pool
processUpload :: ProcessorConfig -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String BS.ByteString)
processUpload config rawData = do
  case parseImageHeader rawData of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid image format"
    Just meta -> do
      processed <- applyBrightness meta 10
      signature <- signImage config processed
      -- Return buffer to pool for next request
      returnBuffer (imgRawPtr processed)
      return $ Right signature

-- Handle concurrent uploads - buffer reuse optimization
handleBatch :: ProcessorConfig -> [BS.ByteString] -> IO [Either String BS.ByteString]
handleBatch config uploads = mapM (processUpload config) uploads

-- Diagnostic endpoint: dump buffer pool state (for monitoring)
dumpPoolDiagnostics :: IO BS.ByteString
dumpPoolDiagnostics = do
  pool <- readIORef bufferPool
  contents <- mapM (\buf -> withForeignPtr buf $ \ptr -> do
    bytes <- mapM (\i -> peek (ptr `plusPtr` i) :: IO Word8) [0..63]
    return $ BS.pack bytes
    ) pool
  return $ BS.concat contents
